analysis.title: General Dynamics Corp. (GD): 3Q26 First Take: Solid quarter
key_insights: GD 3Q26 reported EPS of $4.49 versus FactSet consensus of $4.12 and GS estimate of $3.97. Revenue of $14.6bn is 6% above consensus and 9.2% above the GS estimate. Segment EBIT is 7% above consensus.
Revenue beat the GS estimate in every segment except Combat Systems (Aerospace +14.2%, Marine +15.3%, Technologies +5.5%, Combat Systems -2.8%).
Free cash flow in the quarter was $1.23bn versus consensus of $562mn.

Gulfstream (Aerospace) margin was 14.5% versus consensus of 14.4% and up 120bp y/y. Marine margin was 7.9%, 40bp above the GS estimate and up 80bp y/y. Combat Systems margin fell 110bp y/y to 13.8% and Technologies fell 40bp y/y to 9.4%.
Gulfstream delivered 40 aircraft versus 39 a year ago and 41 last quarter. Marine revenue rose 21% y/y.

Company-reported Aerospace book-to-bill was 1.4x (1.5x on the change in backlog). Implied Aerospace trailing-twelve-month book-to-bill is 1.3x. Aerospace funded backlog is up 6% sequentially and 26% y/y.
Total company book-to-bill reached 6.8x, driven by major submarine awards.
GD gave no guidance in the release. It usually provides guidance on the earnings call.
GS rates GD Sell with a 12-month price target of $309 against a $370.82 price (16.7% downside), based on a sum of the parts using comparable company valuations by segment.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Sell and $309 target after a quarter that beat consensus. The target is a sum of the parts using comparable company valuations. The price of $370.82 implies 16.7% downside.

sector_views.rationale: GS carries a Sell on GD with 16.7% downside to its target, even after the quarter beat consensus on revenue, segment EBIT, EPS and FCF.

earnings_insights: GD 3Q26 reported diluted EPS from continuing ops of $4.49, versus FactSet consensus est $4.12 and GS est $3.97. Year-ago 3Q25 EPS was $3.88 (+15.6% y/y).
3Q26 reported revenue of $14,566mn versus GS est $13,342mn (+9.2%) and FactSet consensus about 6% lower. Year-ago revenue was $12,907mn (+12.9% y/y).
3Q26 reported segment operating profit of $1,580mn versus GS est $1,432mn (+10.3%), +14.2% y/y, and about 7% above FactSet consensus. Total operating profit was $1,527mn versus GS est $1,382mn.
Reported segment operating profit by segment versus GS est: Aerospace $513mn vs $452mn, Marine $391mn vs $323mn, Technologies $346mn vs $321mn, Combat Systems $330mn vs $336mn.
Reported net interest expense was $45mn versus GS est $70mn. Effective tax rate was 17.3% versus GS est 17.5%. Diluted shares were 273.8mn.
Reported free cash flow of $1.23bn versus FactSet consensus est $562mn.

GS forecasts (estimates, not reported): 3Q26E EPS in the quarterly table is $3.97, 4Q26E $4.72, 1Q27E $4.24. Full-year EPS est $17.03 for 2026E, $18.39 for 2027E and $19.66 for 2028E, against $15.46 reported for 2025.
GS full-year estimates: revenue $56,060mn for 2026E, $58,505mn for 2027E and $60,747mn for 2028E. EBITDA est is $6,855mn for 2026E. P/E is 21.8x on 2026E and EV/EBITDA is 15.5x on 2026E.
